results.title: Thalapathy Vijay and Jason Statham in one film? Actor-politician's son Jason Sanjay calls it a 'great collaboration' ahead of directorial debut
results.description: Vijay's son Jason Sanjay is gearing up for his directorial debut with Sigma and has now shared several personal and professional insights in his first interview. From explaining why he chose filmmaking over acting to discussing his early exposure to cinema and an ambitious idea for a future project, the filmmaker's comments have generated plenty of buzz ahead of the film's release.
